title: Sound panel: recordings and voice listed for choosing

spec.phase: Phase UI — Studio design and UX (release 3.0.0)
spec.summary: The Audio panel mixes adding sound, recording voice and track settings in one long scroll, and recorded takes appear only as clips on the timeline: there is no list of recordings with their details, so finding, comparing or reusing a take means scanning the timeline. 505 restructures the sound side: the Audio panel gets folding sections (503) **Add sound**, **Record voice**, **Recordings** and **Tracks**; **Recordings** lists every voice take with name, length, date and time recorded, microphone, the track and time it sits at, and whether it is used; the user plays a take, renames it, selects it on the timeline, adds it again or deletes unused takes. Music, voice and effects are shown apart everywhere (pool filter, track colours, inspector).

US-1.text: As a narrator, I want to see all my takes with their details, so that I can pick the best one.

US-2.text: As a creator, I want music, voice and effects kept apart, so that I can find and adjust each kind.

US-3.text: As a user, I want the Audio panel to show one thing at a time instead of a long scroll.

AC-1.text: The Recordings section lists every take of the project, newest first, with name, length, recorded date and time, microphone name, track and timeline position (or "Not used"); selecting a row selects and reveals its clip on the timeline; play previews it alone; rename changes the clip and pool name (one undo step); delete removes an unused take (a used one asks first).

AC-2.text: Sound is labelled by kind (Music, Voice, Effects) in the pool, the Audio panel, the track headers and the sound inspector, each with its own colour token from 501; takes are Voice.

AC-3.text: The Audio panel has the sections Add sound, Record voice, Recordings and Tracks as folding sections (503); opening Record voice opens the microphone and closing the section closes it (209 AC-7 still holds).

AC-4.text: The maintainer checks the Audio panel with 8 tracks and 20 takes at 1280 × 720 (deferred to 590).

Q1.text: Store the microphone name and record time with a take? _Answer (accepted 2026-10-20):_ yes, as fields of the take's media entry; older takes show "—".

Q2.text: Where is the per-track mixer (volume, solo, ducking)? _Answer (accepted 2026-10-20):_ the Tracks section of the Audio panel and the track header, as now; the sound inspector keeps clip settings only.

changelog.text: Created: draft spec with 4 acceptance criteria and 2 open questions with proposed answers (Phase UI, D-063).
Every proposed answer accepted by the maintainer; Approved.

sections.title: Non-Functional Requirements
sections.markdown:
- **Performance:** no new work on the preview or export path; the entry chunk stays ≤ 350 KB; panels open in under 100 ms.
- **Accessibility:** every control works from the keyboard with a visible focus ring and is announced; axe passes; text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 in the light and dark themes.
- **Compatibility:** web and desktop alike; phones (≤ 640 px) and laptops (1280 × 720) as well as wide screens; every saved project opens unchanged.
- **Free and open source:** no new dependency unless cleared in `specs/licensing.md` first.
- **Privacy:** recording details (microphone name) stay in the project on the device.

sections.title: Out of Scope
sections.markdown:
- Comparing takes as lanes on one track (take lanes).
- New audio processing.
